name: Panther Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Sir S. J. Erlgadin asks you to prove your worth among the seasoned hunters. After your hunt for young panthers, he sends you into Stranglethorn Vale for ten fully grown beasts.

sections.title: A Higher Standard
sections.body: Your hunt for young panthers is done, and Sir S. J. Erlgadin sets a higher standard. He asks you to prove you can keep company with the expedition's seasoned big game hunters. So you set out to track and slay ten mature panthers, stronger and more dangerous than their young kin.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin, a hunter at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, oversees this stage of the hunt.

faq.q: What quarry are you asked to hunt?
faq.answer: You are asked to track and slay ten mature panthers in the surrounding jungle. They are tougher than the younger panthers you hunted before.
An earlier trial, also titled Panther Mastery, tested your skill against younger jungle panthers.

faq.q: What is the purpose of hunting these panthers?
faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin asks you to prove your skill and courage so you can hunt and spend time alongside the expedition's seasoned big game hunters.
